title: Permanent Resident
note: The content on this page is provided as general reference. For the latest and most accurate application requirements and required documents, please refer to the information from the [Immigration Services Agency of Japan](https://www.moj.go.jp/isa/).
tips:
・At least **10 years of continuous residence** are required (a shorter period may apply for the spouse/child of a Japanese national or Permanent Resident).

・With the Highly Skilled Professional **points-based system** score of 70 or higher: eligible to apply after **3+ years** of residence.

・With a score of 80 or higher: eligible to apply after **1+ year** of residence.
